entities.summary: Clayton Stoner is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He was drafted in the third round, 79th overall, by the Minnesota Wild at the 2004 NHL entry draft. Stoner played his entire career with the Wild and the Anaheim Ducks franchises.
